accepted_claims: Formal isosymplectic differential deformation and same-genus immersion with balanced signed transverse double points.
Fixed original split-form sufficiency on S2 x Sigma_h for every h>=0 and all integral input classes meeting the smooth, area, and genus hypotheses.
For positive genus and b2+>1, all Seiberg-Witten basic classes satisfy |L(c)|<=K(c), including negative self-intersection.
remaining_gap: Produce an embedded connected representative of the same integral class for arbitrary original fixed symplectic forms, or a concrete counterexample meeting all smooth, area, and equality hypotheses.
acceptance_basis: Complete written analytic arguments and independently reasoned mathematical audit, with the precisely scoped public theorems cited in those arguments. Recorded finite checks are supporting sanity checks only.
euler_number_clarification: The quotient Euler-number difference vanishes; the quotient Euler number is c^2 and need not vanish.
binding_rule: This public acceptance binds the exact distributed proof and audit bytes listed above. Later changes require rechecking and rebinding.
